items.t: Automatic transmission overheats, slips or fails
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a used or remanufactured unit
items.note: A fluid and filter service ($150-$300) is worth doing first if the transmission still shifts well.

items.t: Crankshaft pulley bolt loosens and pulley comes off
items.job: Replace crankshaft pulley and bolt, and inspect the crank nose and keyway
items.note: If the crankshaft nose is damaged, the repair becomes an engine job and costs far more.

items.t: Crankshaft pulley bolt may loosen (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Mitsubishi dealer

items.t: Frame and subframe rust-through
items.job: Cut out and weld in frame repair sections
items.note: Badly rotted frames are often not worth repairing.

items.t: Horn sounds by itself
items.job: Diagnose horn circuit and replace horn relay or horn switch contacts

items.t: Front brakes wear fast and rotors warp
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Worn tie rods and loose steering
items.job: Replace inner and outer tie rod ends and align

items.t: Fuel leak from the tank after filling up
items.job: Replace fuel tank filler neck hose or fuel tank
items.note: A filler hose is the cheaper fix; a new tank sits at the high end.

items.t: Oil leaks and burning oil smell
items.job: Replace camshaft seals and valve cover gaskets
items.note: Camshaft seals are often replaced with the timing belt to save labor.

items.t: Coolant leaks and overheating
items.job: Replace water pump and timing belt

items.t: Alternator failure and dead battery
items.job: Replace alternator

items.t: Catalytic converter or oxygen sensor failure
items.job: Replace catalytic converter
items.note: RepairPal's dealer-level estimate runs about $2,750-$3,650. Aftermarket converters cost much less. Oxygen sensors run $60-$200 each.

items.t: A/C compressor failure
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, drier, and recharge

items.t: Windshield wiper motor stops working
items.job: Replace windshield wiper motor

items.t: Engine knock on California-market trucks
items.job: Engine knock diagnosis
items.note: Repair cost depends on what is found.

items.t: Valve tapping for a few minutes after cold start
items.job: Oil level check and listen test

items.t: Shudder in tight, low-speed turns
items.job: Rear differential fluid change with limited-slip additive

items.t: Radio noise when the power seat moves
items.job: Replace power seat wiring harness

items.t: Brake vacuum hose can burst (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Mitsubishi dealer

items.t: Transmission fluid can vent onto the exhaust (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Mitsubishi dealer

items.t: Tire and loading label lists wrong weights (recall)
items.job: Recall label replacement
